name: Semantius
description: Semantic data-model platform: PostgreSQL 18 with the pg_semantius extension, a PostgREST HTTP API with OpenAPI docs, and the admin SPA — behind one Caddy front door. Auth is OIDC bearer tokens verified against your issuer's JWKS; the defaults point at a public test issuer, so set VITE_OAUTH_CONFIG and VITE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID to your own IdP before using this for anything real.
